name: Ecchi na Okaa-san to Otoko no Ko to Sono Kareshi
original_name: えっちなお母さんと男の娘とその彼氏
source:
My mother, my mother 
... wanted a girl 

I was born with a penis but 
I'm a girl at heart 
Mama is sad when I get hard 
Then she sucks it off 

Now I have a boyfriend
His name is Masato 

My mother supports our love 
This is our story: her, me and him 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181722.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的母亲，我的母亲……

……想要一个女儿。

我出生时是男孩，

但内心是女孩。

妈妈看到我勃起会难过，

然后她会帮我口交。

现在我有一个男朋友，

他叫雅人。

妈妈支持我们的爱情。

这是她、我和他的故事。
